lines.text: After Abijah was buried in the City of David, his son Asa reigned, and the land had peace ten years.
Asa removed the foreign altars, shattered the sacred pillars, and commanded Judah to seek the LORD.
Asa built fortified cities in Judah and had 300,000 men from Judah and 280,000 men from Ephraim.
Zerah the Cushite advanced to Mareshah, and Asa lined up in the Valley of Elah and cried to the LORD.
The LORD struck down the Cushites, and Judah pursued them to Gerar, took plunder, and returned to Jerusalem.
